name: node_op
description: Manage a device/group/folder node: enable, disable, delete, rename, move it, or create a new group/folder.

node_id.description: Real id of the node to operate on, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE. Not used for add_group/add_folder.

new_name.description: New display name. Required for rename, add_group, add_folder.

new_parent_id.description: Real id of the new parent folder/group. Required for move.
